added_since_deploy.scope_type: AuditQueryScope (All | Principal | Actor{authority,subject}) plus admin_only: bool
added_since_deploy.ordering: Newest first: ORDER BY ts DESC, id DESC (sqlite) / ts DESC, seq DESC (postgres); newer insertions first on timestamp ties
added_since_deploy.description: Newest-first audit query with scope filtering applied before LIMIT; backs GET /admin/audit and GET /admin/v1/audit in the candidate. The new admin_only parameter (API default false; the audit page sends admin_only=true) appends the literal predicate (admin_action IS NOT NULL OR kind IS NOT NULL) before ORDER BY/LIMIT on both engines; both implementations now build the statement with sqlx QueryBuilder (Postgres binds until twice). Existing ascending AuditStore::query_audit and query_audit_by_actor definitions are preserved but are no longer mapped by the HTTP audit handler.

added_since_deploy.name: audit_log_v1 read-order indexes for query_recent_audit
added_since_deploy.description: Five new indexes per engine serve ORDER BY ts DESC, id/seq DESC inside each scope: scoped (principal, actor) plus partial admin_only indexes carrying the identical (admin_action IS NOT NULL OR kind IS NOT NULL) predicate; the Postgres actor index is partial on actor_authority IS NOT NULL. Postgres migrations are plain CREATE INDEX (one per file, lock_timeout 1s): each build holds a SHARE lock that blocks writes to audit_log_v1 for its duration, so a large live deployment MUST stay blocked until an operator pre-creates the indexes with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY using identical definitions and verifies pg_index.indisvalid; no production DDL is authorized. SQLite migration 0088 creates all five indexes in one file. Both engines add real write amplification and WAL/index-build cost; this is not a zero-overhead change.

changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: Accepts query params: since, until, limit, principal_id. No actor filtering. No SensitiveRead authorization enforcement.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Accepts additional query params: actor_authority, actor_subject, admin_only. Enforces validation that both actor params must be supplied together and cannot be combined with principal_id. admin_only (default false) filters to entries with an admin action or kind before LIMIT. 'after' remains an exclusive lower time bound (since = max(since, after+1)), not a forward pagination cursor. changed_contracts.name: Explicit clear_base_url Base URL override reset
changed_contracts.description: Approved on 2026-09-16: PUT/PATCH omission or explicit null preserves base_url, a URL sets it, and clear_base_url: true clears it; sending a non-null base_url together with clear_base_url returns 400 conflicting_base_url (a stale If-Match still wins with 409). The SettingsCard form captures the Base URL baseline when editing begins so a mid-edit props refetch cannot turn an untouched field into a clear, and treats a clear as unconfirmed (error toast, editor stays open) when the response base_url is not null. Both adapters preserve revision/credential semantics. Deployed baseline remains unchanged.
